phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Next.js project setup, Drizzle schema, core types, tooling. No runtime logic yet.

features.name: Next.js project init
features.description: yarn create next-app with App Router, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS, ESLint

features.name: Drizzle ORM setup
features.description: Install drizzle-orm + drizzle-kit + postgres driver. Configure drizzle.config.ts.

features.name: Drizzle schema
features.description: Full schema: marketSnapshots, signals, signalFills, signalEvents with all enums. Single source of truth.

features.name: Initial migration
features.description: yarn db:generate && yarn db:migrate — creates all tables

features.name: Core types
features.description: src/core/types.ts: Candle, Bias, Momentum, Side, IndicatorSet, EntrySignal, PositionSize, StrategyConfig, DEFAULT_CONFIG (LOOSE-3)

features.name: ESLint + Prettier
features.description: Shared config + pre-commit hook via lint-staged

features.name: Vitest config
features.description: vitest.config.ts — separate from Next.js jest config, coverage threshold 80%

features.name: Environment template
features.description: Complete .env.example with all required variables documented

phases.name: Core Logic
phases.description: Pure business logic with full test coverage. Zero I/O. Lives in src/core/.
phases.gate: All tests pass. validate-indicators matches TradingView within 0.01%.

features.name: SMA indicator
features.description: sma(values, period): Decimal[] — undefined for first period-1 bars

features.name: EMA indicator
features.description: ema(values, period): Decimal[] — Wilder seeding (SMA of first N bars). Must match TradingView ta.ema().

features.name: ATR indicator
features.description: atr(candles, period): Decimal[] — RMA/Wilder smoothing (NOT SMA). Seed with SMA of first N TRs.

features.name: Validate vs TradingView
features.description: scripts/validate-vs-pine.ts: load known BTC 1H klines, compute EMA14/ATR20, compare vs TradingView reference values. Must be within 0.01%.

features.name: Bias strategy
features.description: computeBias(dailyClose, sma99, neutralPct): Bias

features.name: Momentum strategy
features.description: computeMomentum(ema14, ema60, ema14Prev): Momentum

features.name: Entry strategy (LOOSE-3)
features.description: checkEntry(params): EntrySignal | null — all 5 long/short conditions, pullbackAtrMult=0.3

features.name: Exit strategy
features.description: evaluateExit(params): ExitDecision — HOLD | TP1 | TP2 | SL | TRAIL_UPDATE. Stateless.

features.name: Position sizing
features.description: calculatePositionSize(params): PositionSize — 1% fixed risk, 5 decimal precision

phases.name: Backtest
phases.description: Validate strategy on 2 years of real BTC data. Must pass gate before Phase 4.
phases.gate: Trades > 50, PF > 1.3, MaxDD < 25%, within ±5% of TradingView Pine backtest.

features.name: History seeder
features.description: scripts/seed-history.ts — fetch 2y BTC/USDT 1H + 1D klines from Binance, cache to JSON

features.name: Backtest runner
features.description: backtest/runner.ts — bar-by-bar replay using same checkEntry + evaluateExit as production

features.name: Backtest metrics
features.description: backtest/metrics.ts — Total Trades, Win Rate, Profit Factor, Max Drawdown, Avg R:R, Sharpe, Expectancy

features.name: Backtest report
features.description: backtest/report.ts — print summary to console + write per-trade CSV

features.name: Backtest script
features.description: scripts/backtest-loose3.ts — entry point: load cache → run → print report

phases.name: Adapters + API Routes + Worker
phases.description: I/O wiring. Requires Phase 3 gate to pass first.
phases.gate: Local integration test: real Postgres + Redis + Binance + Telegram all working.

features.name: Binance adapter
features.description: fetchKlines(symbol, interval, limit): Candle[] — zod validation, exponential backoff (3 retries, base 1s)

features.name: Telegram adapter
features.description: sendAlert(signal, eventType): Promise<void> — Markdown v2, escape special chars, log ALERT_FAILED on failure

features.name: DB adapter (Drizzle)
features.description: Drizzle client singleton. Connection pooling. No business logic.

features.name: Redis adapter
features.description: get/set/del with TTL. Used for bias cache + deduplication.

features.name: bias-1d API route
features.description: POST /api/bias-1d — fetch 1D klines, compute SMA99, update bias in Redis, log BIAS_UPDATED

features.name: signal-1h API route
features.description: POST /api/signal-1h — read bias from Redis, compute indicators, evaluate LOOSE-3 entry, create Signal, send alert

features.name: position-manager API route
features.description: POST /api/position-manager — fetch active signals, evaluate exits, update SL/trail, record fills, send alerts

features.name: Worker (node-cron)
features.description: src/worker/index.ts — cron scheduler: bias-1d daily, signal-1h hourly, position-manager every 5min. Calls API routes via HTTP.

features.name: Dry-run mode
features.description: DRY_RUN=true — compute + alert + log events but do NOT persist Signal row. Tag alerts with [DRY_RUN].

phases.name: Dashboard UI
phases.description: Next.js App Router pages for reviewing signals and performance.
phases.gate: All data renders correctly from Postgres. Charts display equity curve.

features.name: Dashboard home page
features.description: / — equity curve (Recharts), current open signal card, today's stats (trades, PnL)

features.name: Signals list page
features.description: /signals — table of all signals: status badge, side, entry, SL, TP1, TP2, realized PnL, R:R

features.name: Signal detail page
features.description: /signals/[id] — fills timeline, events log, indicator values at entry

features.name: Shared UI components
features.description: StatusBadge, SignalCard, PnlCell, MetricStat — reusable across pages

services: Binance REST API (market data — no auth needed)
concepts: Technical analysis: SMA, EMA, ATR, trend-following
Risk management: fixed fractional sizing, R:R ratio
Backtesting: bar-by-bar replay, equity curve, drawdown
Next.js App Router: RSC, route handlers, server actions
Drizzle ORM: schema definition, migrations, query builder
